High-purity elemental constituents (purity > 99 wt. %) were arc-melted in a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere. To ensure chemical homogeneity, the melting process was repeated at least four times.
The molten alloys were then drop-cast into a copper mold with a dimension of 10 × 10 × 50 mm3.

evidence.quote: those microcracks initiate at HAGBs, and terminate at intergranular D019-structured precipitates, which strongly suggests that the coherent intergranular precipitates can effectively obstruct the propagation of microcracks along HAGBs

mechanisms.name: heat-assisted twinning facilitated by Nb segregation
